item.title: YouTube removes the guesswork by expanding monetization for controversial content
item.description: YouTube's guidelines for ad-friendly content are changing, and creators who cover controversial topics are in line for increased revenue. Videos that touch on certain sensitive issues will now be eligible for full monetization so long as they avoid graphic depictions of those subjects. item.description: In the span of a few short years, generative AI has gone from a futuristic afterthought to an ubiquitous innovation. item.description: In a few short months, podcasts have gone from a non-factor in Netflix's library to key element of the company's strategy.
